Title: Public preview: Azure Monitor and Azure Managed Grafana integrations

Body.Content:
Along with the announcement of Azure Managed Grafana, we are introducing new Grafana integrations with Azure Monitor. Using Azure Managed Grafana, you can now view your Azure monitoring data in Grafana dashboards in a few simple clicks:

  • Quickly pin Azure Monitor visualizations from the Azure Portal to new or existing Grafana dashboards by adding panels to your Grafana dashboard directly from Azure Monitor metrics and logs. 
  • Combine app and infrastructure metrics from multiple Azure sources into a single dashboard for full stack visibility.
  • Easily get started with full-stack Azure application and infrastructure monitoring using out-of-the-box Grafana dashboards.

Learn more about the Grafana and Azure Monitor integrations on this Tech Community blog.
